_description: Default counting-feature analysis settings. Only values under 'config' affect runs; 'notes' is documentation for humans.

notes.TASK_TYPE: Counting task variant. match_count asks for the number of city score records; use other supported Dynamic NIAH tasks only when the prompt/query logic supports them.
notes.SMOKE_TEST: When true, derived defaults become smaller for quick checks. Current experiment defaults keep this false.
notes.NUM_EXAMPLES: Number of main dataset examples. Increasing this affects dataset generation, baseline generation, hidden-state extraction, and feature fitting.
notes.NUM_MAX_NEEDLES: Optional variable-count generation control. null keeps fixed NUM_NEEDLES; a positive integer samples each example's target count uniformly from 1..NUM_MAX_NEEDLES.
notes.RANDOMIZE_NEEDLE_INSERTION: When true, insertion positions are sampled rather than using fixed token offsets.
notes.SENTENCE_LEVEL_INSERTION: When true, randomized insertion places needles after sentence-ending delimiters instead of arbitrary token offsets.
notes.WORD_LEVEL_INSERTION: When true, randomized insertion places needles at whitespace boundaries between non-whitespace text chunks. Mutually exclusive with SENTENCE_LEVEL_INSERTION.
notes.COUNTING_NEEDLE_KIND: Needle content family for match_count. city_score keeps the existing city-score records; marker inserts exact repeated MARKER_TEXT copies.
notes.MARKER_TEXT: Exact marker inserted when COUNTING_NEEDLE_KIND is marker. The plan-v8 marker is [dolphin].
notes.UID_TOKEN_LENGTH: Desired tokenizer length for generated literal_count UID needles.
notes.LAYERS: Transformer layers used for hidden-state extraction and steering-vector fitting.
notes.PROMPT_STYLE: Prompt wrapper style used by Dynamic NIAH generation. vanilla is the current preferred style for this experiment; vanilla_no_cue is available for marker-count runs.
notes.SAVE_GENERATED_DATA: When true, generated datasets are saved in the reusable data cache for matching reruns.
notes.TARGET_COUNT_TYPE: How token-level count labels are assigned for ridge-style analysis. interpolation assigns fractional values inside needle spans.
notes.MAX_TRAIN_TOKENS_PER_LAYER: Training-token cap for ridge/classifier fitting. Lower values reduce runtime and memory but may make probes noisier.
notes.MAX_EVAL_TOKENS_PER_LAYER: Evaluation-token cap for ridge/classifier fitting. Lower values reduce runtime and memory but may make metrics noisier.
notes.RUN_COUNTING_FEATURE_CALC: When false, skips Block 8 feature-vector calculation. Later steering/eval blocks can still run only if matching feature-vector files already exist.
notes.RUN_NEEDLE_SENSITIVITY: When true, runs same-length single-needle removal sensitivity analysis after tokenization/model loading. This streams target-position hidden states and does not save full perturbed sequence hidden states.
notes.NUM_REMOVAL: Number of matching needles sampled for single-needle removal per included example.
notes.TARGET_SENSITIVITY_POSITION: Position where sensitivity hidden states are measured. The first implementation supports last-token.
notes.NEEDLE_SENSITIVITY_SEED: Seed for deterministic needle-removal and replacement-segment sampling.
notes.MAX_SENSITIVITY_EXAMPLES: Optional cap for initial sensitivity smoke tests. null analyzes all selected examples with enough matching needles.
notes.FILTER_EXAMPLE: When true, counting-feature calculation uses only successful model-response examples. When false, otherwise valid unsuccessful examples are included too.
notes.COUNTING_FEATURE_CALC_METHOD: Feature-vector method: ridge, contrastive-success, or counterfactual. Current experiments focus on counterfactual.
notes.COUNTING_PROBE_MODE: Probe workflow for ridge runs. direct preserves the existing token-level ridge/classifier pipeline; diagnostic values are occurrence_index_probe, mean_across_needles_span_last, mean_across_needles_span_mean, final_token, or all_diagnostics.
notes.RUN_COUNTING_PROBE_BASELINE: When true, non-direct diagnostic probes also fit a fake-position baseline to test whether count prediction could be driven by position-correlated hidden states.
notes.COUNTING_PROBE_BASELINE_MIN_DISTANCE: Preferred minimum token distance between baseline fake positions and all needle spans. If too few positions exist, the code warns and uses available outside-needle positions.
notes.FEATURE_CALC_POS: Position for non-ridge feature extraction. needle-last uses the final token inside the final matching needle span; last uses the final prompt token.
notes.STEERING_POSITION_MODE: Where steering is applied during generation. needle_span applies it at matching needle-span positions; last_token applies it only at the final prompt token.
notes.STEERING_COEFF: Beta values swept during steering. Larger magnitudes can change outputs but may introduce off-target behavior.
notes.STEERING_TEST_EVAL: When true, runs additional held-out-style steering evaluation datasets after the main steering setup. This can substantially increase runtime.
notes.NUM_MAX_NEEDLES_STEERING_EVAL: Maximum gold count K for held-out steering evaluation. The notebook generates datasets for counts 1..K.
notes.NUM_EXAMPLES_STEERING_EVAL: Number of examples per held-out steering-eval count dataset.
notes.STEERING_EVAL_RANDOMIZE_NEEDLE_MIN_SEPAR: Minimum token separation for token-randomized steering-eval insertion. With sentence-level insertion, sentence-ending sites control placement instead.
